canonical_channels.name: recruiting_agency
canonical_channels.label: Recruiting Agency
canonical_channels.note: Workers deployed through licensed recruitment agencies.

canonical_channels.name: individual_new
canonical_channels.label: Individual (New)
canonical_channels.note: Modern tables' new-entry individual channel (not via RA, not G-to-G).

canonical_channels.name: g2g
canonical_channels.label: Government-to-Government
canonical_channels.note: Government-to-government channel; only the modern template breaks this out separately.

canonical_channels.name: legalization
canonical_channels.label: Legalization / Regularization
canonical_channels.note: Regularization of previously irregular workers. Printed as 'Legalization' (modern), 'Legalized Entry' (old), 'Regularized Entry' (Annex IX), 'Individual Regularization' (Annex X).

canonical_channels.name: new_entry
canonical_channels.label: New Entry (old template)
canonical_channels.note: Old-template new-entry channel. NOT split into individual_new vs g2g, so it is kept distinct; treat as new entries when the g2g split is unavailable.

canonical_channels.name: individual
canonical_channels.label: Individual (all modes)
canonical_channels.note: Annex XII district table: individual approvals summed over modes. Aggregate of individual_new + individual_reentry; do not add to components.

canonical_channels.name: total_with_reentry
canonical_channels.label: Total with Re-entry
canonical_channels.note: Printed row total including re-entries. Annex X prints the same as 'Total with Renew'.

canonical_channels.name: total_without_reentry
canonical_channels.label: Total without Re-entry
canonical_channels.note: Printed row total excluding re-entries. Annex X prints the same as 'Total without Renew'.

canonical_channels.name: preapproval
canonical_channels.label: Pre-approval
canonical_channels.note: Pre-approval list total; no channel breakdown. A distinct measure, not a deployment channel.
